title: Salmon tikka with cauliflower
summary: Salmon tikka with cauliflower is a indian dinner built around salmon fillets and cauliflower, with the portions weighed so each serving stays under 700 kcal.

steps.instruction: Heat the fan oven to 200°C. Cut the vegetables for Salmon tikka with cauliflower into even pieces and toss cauliflower with a teaspoon of the oil and a pinch of salt in the tin.
steps.tip: Even pieces cook at the same rate, so nothing is burnt while something else is still raw.

steps.instruction: Roast that first tray of cauliflower while you season salmon fillets. Pat it dry so the surface browns instead of steaming.
Nestle salmon fillets and 0% fat Greek style yoghurt among the vegetables. Roast until the protein is cooked through and the vegetables are tender.
steps.tip: Taste Salmon tikka with cauliflower before serving and add a squeeze of lemon if it wants brightness.

steps.instruction: Rest the tin for a few minutes, taste, and spoon Salmon tikka with cauliflower into warm bowls with the juices.
